Holdet består af unge, dygtige dansere,: The team consists of young, skilled dancers and requires you to be 17 or older. The road to success goes through hard work and many hours of training.
Holdet byder på energi, højt tempo og fl: The team offers energy, high tempo and great moves for anyone who wants to try disco – and you get the best of two styles. Disco: fast, powerful dancing to energetic music, with expression, quick movements and full speed. Disco Slow: built on the same basic steps but danced to calmer music with a focus on control, balance and technique. You learn short sequences and combinations so you can join in quickly. We dance both solo and together, training tempo, technique and expression. The team is open to everyone regardless of level and experience. Come along and enjoy lots of dance joy!
Holdet er et kærligt og sanseligt danseu: The team is a loving, sensory dance universe for children aged 0–2, who take part together with mum or dad. The aim is not to learn choreography – it's about moving together, strengthening the bond between child and parent and experiencing the joy of music and rhythm. We dance and play with simple props such as scarves and balls. The pace is calm so big and small can join in. The team builds the child's motor skills, balance and body awareness and gives time for presence, laughter and musical joy. A cosy, sensory moment full of movement, stardust and smiles – for you and your little dance partner.
Holdet er for børn, der gerne vil lave t: The team is for kids who want to do tricks and jumps and challenge themselves. We work on basic jumping technique and learn floor tricks in a safe, fun community, whether or not you've tried before. We train on airtrack and floor – including rolls, cartwheels, handstands and back walkovers. There is also strength training, especially for arms and core, so the children become more confident and brave in their movements. The team is for all levels and no prior knowledge is required.
Holdet er for dansere, der allerede har: The team is for dancers who already have experience with contemporary or related styles and want to grow technically and artistically.
Holdet er for dansere, der vil udforske: The team is for dancers who want to explore a more expressive, artistic style where movement, emotion and storytelling connect. It is for both complete beginners and those who have danced before.
Holdet er for de unge Mini Børn-dansere,: The team is for young Mini Kids dancers who like doing tricks and jumps. We work on basic jumping technique and new movements, whether you can already do a cartwheel or have never tried. We use the airtrack and practise rolls, cartwheels, back walkovers and other floor tricks. We also train strength, especially in the arms, so participants become more confident and brave – even if they're a little unsure at first. The team is for all levels. The goal is to have fun, get stronger and learn new things together.
Holdet er for små børn på alle niveauer,: The team is for small children of all levels, from beginners to more experienced dancers. We work on rhythm, balance and coordination in a playful, encouraging environment. The focus is on fun, friendship and the joy of dancing.
Holdet henvender sig til dansere, der al: The team is for dancers who already know disco and want to develop further. There is community across ages, where older and younger dancers help each other with friendship and dance development. We work purposefully on technique, jumps and choreography. You develop both solo and in duo, learn to perform with confidence and energy, and become part of a safe, fun and motivating environment. Training happens with a smile, and we look forward to seeing you both in training and on stage.
Holdet henvender sig til dansere, der el: The team is for dancers who love hip hop and want to develop their dancing. Experience with dance and choreography is expected, as well as the ability to learn quickly, work with detail and perform with expression and intensity. High demands are made on technique, energy and attitude in a motivating, supportive and ambitious environment where there is also room for fun.
Holdet henvender sig til øvede+ og elite: The team is for advanced+ and elite dancers who want to work purposefully and go deep into the details. The community is safe, committed and serious, and all ages dance together. Dancers lift each other technically and inspire each other creatively. Dance is not only about moving – it's about feeling and touching others with your movement.
Holdet hjælper børn med at blive stærker: The team helps children get stronger so they can master the movements they dream of. We focus on: Strong arms – the children learn to keep their arms extended for elegant lines. Body control – they learn to engage the core for stability and balance. Optimal breathing – they learn to breathe correctly so the muscles get enough oxygen and don't burn out. The team combines strength, technique and body awareness and gives a solid foundation for dancing. It should be fun, challenging and motivating.
Holdet lægger vægt på intensitet, udtryk: The team emphasises intensity, expression and technical precision. Dancers learn to understand and convey emotion through movement. We work with in-depth choreography, improvisation and performance, and each dancer is helped towards a strong, personal expression. On the team we work on: Advanced contemporary technique and floor work. Dynamic movement quality and lines. Storytelling, emotional expression and musicality. Improvisation and creative work. Performance and stage presentation.
Holdet træner én gang om måneden i 4 tim: The team trains once a month for 4 hours (see calendar) with an intensive focus on choreography, performance and development. To maintain and keep improving the level, all dancers must also attend an elective team once a week – this is both a requirement and a wish.
